text: The Earth orbits the Sun once approximately every 365.25 days.
Water is a chemical compound made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom, with the formula H2O.
Bengaluru is the capital city of the Indian state of Karnataka.
Karnataka is a state located in the southwestern region of India.
The Moon is a natural satellite of the Earth and is made primarily of rock, not cheese.
Mount Everest, located in the Himalayas, is the tallest mountain above sea level on Earth.
The human heart has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles.
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to synthesize food from carbon dioxide and water.
The Great Wall of China was built over centuries by several Chinese dynasties to protect against invasions.
Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language first released in 1991.
The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second.
India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's five oceans.
DNA, or deoxyribonucleic acid, carries the genetic instructions used in the growth and functioning of living organisms.
The French Revolution began in 1789 and led to the end of the French monarchy.
